bile_duct_upper_end.name: Upper end of the bile duct curve (where a cystic and common hepatic duct would join; neither is in the source)
bile_duct_upper_end.derived: highest end of Z-Anatomy curve 'Bile duct' (spline 0); the curve is rigidly corrected (rotated 18.6 deg about its upper end, lower end moved 2.37 cm onto the posteromedial wall of the descending duodenum; tools/organs/corrections.json bile_duct_onto_d2)

gallbladder_neck.name: Gallbladder neck (gallbladder surface point nearest the upper end of the bile duct)
gallbladder_neck.derived: baked 'gallbladder' vertex nearest landmark 'bile_duct_upper_end' (0.12 cm away); that landmark is on a rigidly corrected curve (see its note and tools/organs/corrections.json)

gallbladder_fundus.name: Gallbladder fundus (gallbladder surface point farthest from the neck)

gallbladder_centroid.name: Gallbladder centroid
gallbladder_centroid.derived: volume centroid of the baked 'gallbladder' mesh

bile_duct_lower_end.name: Lower (duodenal) end of the bile duct curve
bile_duct_lower_end.derived: end point of centre line 'bile_duct' (Z-Anatomy curve 'Bile duct'); the curve is rigidly corrected (rotated 18.6 deg about its upper end, lower end moved 2.37 cm onto the posteromedial wall of the descending duodenum; tools/organs/corrections.json bile_duct_onto_d2)
